paragraphs.text: The school in Brackwell closed in 2009, when only nine pupils were left. Families with children moved away, and the building was used as a store for farm machinery.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: In 2021 four families with young children bought houses in the village, and the council agreed to reopen the school for one class of mixed ages. A single teacher works there, helped by parents two mornings a week.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: The school closed because the building was unsafe.
The building was empty between 2009 and 2021.
The new class has pupils of different ages.
The teacher previously worked in a city school.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
